summary: Phase 1 adversarial probes confirm both review nits as live checker defects that must be fixed before acceptance. The probe harness (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/adversarial-p1.sh) builds full fixture trees under /tmp/opencode/adv-p1-civic from the committed inventory, TSV, and unmodified checker, stubs the 150 named files, and proves fidelity first: the unmutated control passes 9 of 9. ADV-P1-01 proves P1-c is presence-only: an inventory with the apothecary row changed to MAPS rating: 9.9 and a fabricated note passes the phase gate exit 0. ADV-P1-02 proves the maker family value is never validated: maker: Claude Sonnet 4.5 (claude family) passes exit 0. ADV-P1-03 proves the F2 substring defect: with scenes/maps/inn.ts removed and the inn state cell still inventoried, the checker prints PASS: P1-d row for inn is missing because the note holds the word missing; the exit 1 comes only from the P1-b path FAIL. The strength probes hold: duplicate rows (watchtower replaced by a second apothecary row) fail with 11 FAILs, a full slug mutation to apothecarie fails with 11 FAILs, a rated state cell fails with 2 FAILs, and a claude-family judge claim fails P1-c. One new informational gap: ADV-P1-06 mutates only the Slug cell (apothecarie) while keeping the paths, and the checker passes exit 0 because no check parses the Slug cell against the TSV scene_id. The committed inventory itself is faithful: the control passes, and a spot check agrees with bench/sonnet/log.tsv line 634 (apothecary 7.0, not re-viewed by orchestrator); reviews A and C verified all 30 rows word for word. The defects are in the Red checker, not in the inventory: route the fix to Red per the orchestrator brief.
blocking_findings: ADV-1 [Blocker] adversarial-testing: check-inventory.sh P1-c (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-inventory.sh:80-99) tests only the labeled presence of MAPS rating:, judge: no, and maker:, so a fabricated MAPS rating, a fabricated note, and a claude-family maker value all pass the phase gate. Fixture proof: ADV-P1-01 (apothecary row changed to MAPS rating: 9.9 and MAPS note: totally fabricated by the maker) passes 9 of 9 with exit 0, and ADV-P1-02 (maker: Claude Sonnet 4.5, a claude-family value) passes 9 of 9 with exit 0. Rationale: test-strategy.md section 5 P1-c (lines 115-116) claims each row records the MAPS rating and note from bench/sonnet/log.tsv and the maker family, and section 2 counts the recorded MAPS rating as the first rating of the stop rule, so the phase gate must fail on a wrong value, not only on a missing label; the fix routes to Red, the checker owner, and this role fixed nothing itself. The stated P1-c falsifier (a judge-claim row) is enforced and holds (ADV-P1-08), but the value claim has no automated falsifier today.
nonblocking_findings: ADV-2 [Nit] adversarial-testing: check-inventory.sh P1-d absent-source branch (measure/runs/asset_scenes_civic_20260928/check-inventory.sh:110-114) matches the substring missing anywhere in the row instead of in the state cell. Fixture proof: ADV-P1-03 removes scenes/maps/inn.ts while the inn row keeps state inventoried and its committed note missing hanging lantern; the checker prints PASS: P1-d row for inn is missing (source absent), and the run exits 1 only because of the P1-b path-existence FAIL, so the mislabeled state itself is accepted. Rationale: latent in Phase 1 only while all 30 sources exist; the second P1-d loop (lines 127-145) already parses the state cell exactly, so the absent-source branch should reuse that parse. Red owns this fix together with ADV-1; the probe ADV-P1-03 stays red until the state cell, not the note, satisfies the branch.

ADV-3 [Nit] adversarial-testing: no check parses the inventory Slug cell against the TSV scene_id. Fixture proof: ADV-P1-06 mutates only the Slug cell (apothecary to apothecarie) while keeping all five paths, and the checker passes 9 of 9 with exit 0, because every slug grep matches the row through its intact paths. Rationale: the Slug column is the human-facing key that Phase 2 batch records and the plan gate cite; a slug cell that disagrees with the TSV would pass the gate today. The full slug mutation (slug and paths renamed, ADV-P1-05) is caught with 11 FAILs, so only the cell-value check is missing.

ADV-4 [Nit] adversarial-testing: the P1-b disk-existence check makes the missing state unreachable in a passing run. Evidence: in ADV-P1-03 the only FAIL for the absent source is P1-b named path absent on disk, and test-strategy.md section 5 P1-b lists any absent named path as its falsifier, so a legitimately missing map always fails the gate through P1-b even when its row is correctly labeled missing. Rationale: no action is required while all 30 sources exist; Red should decide while fixing ADV-2 whether a correctly labeled missing row needs a P1-b exemption, so the gate and the strategy stay consistent if a source is ever absent.
